name: gwead_intrinsics
$comment: The `bind:native_impl:` grants are the manifest half of the two-key binding rule; the operator half is `INTRINSIC_NATIVE_BINDINGS` in kernel/mod.rs (see its doc comment).
description: The 11 kernel-shipped step type definitions. See the crate-level docs (src/lib.rs) for the native/intrinsic/control-flow split.

ifs.description: Ordered branches, like a match: the first whose `test` is truthy runs. A branch with no `test` always matches, so an else is a final untested branch; it must be last.

test.description: Bare DSL condition (no surrounding braces). Omit or null for the always-matching final branch.

then.description: Steps run when this branch wins.

outputSchema.description: Control-flow step. Surfaces no value of its own; downstream reads the executed branch's inner step results by their ids.

path.description: DSL reference selecting the array to iterate. Each element is bound to `$item` inside the body.

steps.description: Body steps run once per element; may reference `$item`. Inner results are cleared at the top of each iteration.

collect.description: DSL expression evaluated after each iteration; the assembled array becomes this step's result. Optional — without it the step's result is an empty array.

outputSchema.description: With `collect`, the array of per-iteration collected values; otherwise an empty array (the last iteration's inner step results survive under their own ids).

count.description: Iteration count (number or template). Acts as the safety cap when `until` is present. `$item` is the 0-based iteration index.

until.description: DSL do-until condition evaluated after each body run; truthy exits early. Optional.

collect.description: DSL expression collected per iteration into this step's result array. Optional.

outputSchema.description: With `collect`, the array of per-iteration collected values; otherwise an empty array.

plugin.description: Target plugin name (template-resolved). Mutually exclusive with `role`.

role.description: Target SPI role, e.g. SOME_ROLE (template-resolved); the orchestrator picks the plugin. Mutually exclusive with `plugin`.

input.description: Input resolved against the parent context; stream handles and step results flow through. The callee's config comes from the dispatch orchestrator; its secrets are pulled for its own identity through the kernel's SecretResolver.

hints.description: Optional hints nudging the dispatch orchestrator, e.g. {"flavor": "fast"}. Opaque to the kernel.

outputSchema.description: The invoked action's output. Recursion is capped at depth 16.

branches.description: List of branches; each branch is a step list run concurrently on its own forked state. Step ids must be unique across branches.

outputSchema.description: Array of each branch's last step result, in declaration order regardless of finish order.

value.description: Value resolved (type-preserving) and used as the action's output, unwinding the action in place of resultsPath / resultMapping.

outputSchema.description: Unwinds the action; the resolved `value` becomes the action output.

catch.description: Recovery steps; may reference `{{$.error}}`. Absent → failure propagates; `[]` (empty) → failure swallowed, result null; non-empty → runs on failure.

finally.description: Steps that run after the try or catch steps, whether they failed or not; a finally failure supersedes everything. Not run after a `return` inside the try or catch, nor on an error that ends the invocation (a cancellation, a step-results budget violation), which unwinds without them. Optional.

outputSchema.description: On success, the last `try` step's result; on caught failure, the last `catch` step's result; with empty `catch`, null.

module.description: Name of an entry in this manifest's `wasmModules`.

entry.description: Entry function name. Typed `() -> ()` — no args, no return, no host imports; modules must be self-contained.

outputSchema.description: No value (the entry fn is typed `() -> ()`).

value.description: Value to originate; resolved recursively and type-preserving, then returned as the step result. `storeToVariable` names it if wanted.

language.description: Selector routing to the script runtime registered for this language (e.g. `lua`). Required: the kernel ships no runtime and has no default language.

source.description: Script source. Reads the action context via the runtime's host API (e.g. Lua `args`).

code.description: Structured error code callers branch on.

params.description: Structured params attached to the error (template-resolved). Optional.

outputSchema.description: Never produces a value — always raises a structured PluginError.
